temporal_state_chain.observed: At the funeral, Sara sees Shirley's somber demeanor and hears Shirley say it has been tough, that she keeps thinking if more could have been done, and that it is hard to let go.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara knew Shirley cared about the patient and would be sad, but she had not yet formed a clear belief about how deeply Shirley was affected.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Sara's suspicion that Shirley is deeply affected is confirmed; she also learns Shirley is wrestling with self-doubt about whether more could have been done.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is grieving deeply, may be second-guessing their care, and is struggling to accept the loss.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Sympathy, concern, and compassion for Shirley.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To comfort and reassure Shirley, remind her of the good care provided, and help her begin to let go.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During a coffee break, Sara raises the patient's treatment; Shirley admits she feels responsible and wonders if pushing for a different approach might have helped.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley was grieving deeply and possibly second-guessing their care, but she had not confirmed that Shirley felt personally responsible.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Sara learns that Shirley explicitly carries guilt and a sense of responsibility for the treatment outcome.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is burdened by misplaced guilt about the patient's death and needs help accepting that the team made the best decisions with the information they had.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern, empathy, and a desire to relieve Shirley's guilt.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To alleviate Shirley's sense of responsibility by validating their shared decisions and offering support so she does not carry the burden alone.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara notices Shirley has remained reserved and minimally expressive; when confronted, Shirley says she fears seeming unprofessional or weak if she opens up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley was grieving and burdened by guilt, and that she might be holding back her feelings.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Sara learns the specific reason Shirley hides her emotions is fear of appearing unprofessional or weak.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley needs reassurance that expressing emotion is healthy and acceptable, especially among friends, and that Shirley is willing to try being more open.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern mixed with gentle urgency and some worry that Shirley is isolating herself emotionally.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To encourage Shirley to express her feelings and reassure her that vulnerability is not weakness.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara apologizes for possibly coming on too strong; Shirley says it was a bit much but acknowledges Sara meant well and appreciates the apology.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed she might have overstepped or been too harsh in confronting Shirley about her emotions, and she wanted to mend any rift.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Sara learns Shirley was somewhat overwhelmed but not alienated, and that Shirley values the apology and wants to keep talking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes the friendship can be repaired and that Shirley still trusts and appreciates her support; continued conversation is welcome.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Relief, regret for any harshness, and warmth toward Shirley.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To repair the relationship, be more careful in how she offers support, and remain available for Shirley.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After some time, Sara notices Shirley's demeanor has improved; Shirley says she feels better because of their talks and Sara's support and agrees to spend time together outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believed Shirley was still grieving but that their repaired relationship and ongoing talks were a source of support; she had not yet confirmed clear sustained improvement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Sara observes clear improvement and learns Shirley credits their talks and support; Shirley is also willing to deepen the friendship outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is recovering, that her support has been helpful, and that their friendship is strengthening.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue supporting Shirley and to plan time together outside work, such as for the weekend.
